description: Steps 4-6 on a geometrically motivated candidate for the D=12 S-shaped surface. Combinatorial Rauzy class of an irreducible 3-letter permutation compatible with three cylinders; 4D matrices are the residual-0-corrected generators and their monoid.
honesty_note: Executed on a candidate irreducible permutation compatible with the three-cylinder + Prym geometry. Not claimed to be the certified geometric Rauzy class of the S-surface.
